standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.zh: 我在找我的 T 恤。

entries.en: Which one are you looking for?
The red one with the flower on it.
entries.zh: 那件带花朵的红色 T 恤。

entries.en: I can’t find it anywhere and I’ve got to go out in five minutes.
entries.zh: 我到处都找不到，而且再过五分钟我就得出门了。

entries.en: To the cinema with Lucy and Darcy.
Do you want to borrow one of mine?
Just get one from my room but don’t make a mess.
entries.zh: 去我房间拿一件就行，但别弄得一团糟。

entries.en: Can I borrow your red boots, too?
entries.zh: 我也能借你的红色靴子吗？

entries.en: I know I am the world’s best sister, Lori, but there are some times when I have to say ‘no’!
entries.zh: 我知道我是全世界最好的姐姐，洛丽，但有时候我也得说“不”！

entries.en: Have we got any plans this weekend?
entries.zh: 这个周末我们有什么安排吗？

entries.en: There’s a party at Nathan’s place.
His family have got an amazing house.
entries.zh: 他家有一栋很棒的房子。

entries.en: And I guess there are no buses at that time of night.
entries.zh: 我猜那个时间晚上没有公交车。

entries.en: Umm, no, I don’t think so.
Well, no actually, there aren’t any buses, no.
entries.zh: 嗯，其实没有，确实没有公交车。

entries.en: Let’s hear the next question, Tom.
entries.zh: 汤姆，听听你的下一个问题。

entries.en: Any chance of a lift, Mum?
Of course, but I need to pick you up by midnight at the latest.
entries.zh: 当然可以，但我最晚午夜得去接你。

entries.en: I need my sleep, you know.
